newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's 1996 gold output seen below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's 1996 gold output seen below forecast.

text.p: Zimbabwe's 1996 gold production may not reach the projected forecast of 26 tonnes due to reduced output during the second half of the year, a Chamber of Mines official said on Wednesday.
The official, who declined to be named, told Reuters that provisional statistics indicate that this year's annual output may not exceed 1995's 24.3 tonnes.
"I think some houses cut back their production when they realised that the gold price in United States dollar terms was not rising or as good as they had expected," he said.
Output in the first 11 months of the year rose to 23 tonnes of gold compared to 22.2 tonnes in the same period in 1995.

Gold production in Zimbabwe had been rising by about two tonnes annually in the past three years on the back of increased exploration and investment as the economy opened up under market-led economic reforms started in 1991. --Cris Chinaka, Harare Newsroom: +263-4 72 52 27/8/9
